idea: Auto-pass all reconciliations with no sampled attestation
argue_for: Removes the remaining ~250 h [A] of reconciliation attestation.
argue_against: Loses independent evidence; RCD-037 makes the sample a close gate.
revisit_if: Auditor accepts continuous-control evidence without sampling.

idea: Publish every NAV by policy including out-of-tolerance ones
argue_against: Out-of-tolerance prices are where errors concentrate; RCD-035 requires a human there.
revisit_if: Never.

idea: Replace append-only storage with mutable tables plus an audit log
argue_against: Audit logs can be bypassed; corrections lose provenance.
revisit_if: Never for storage-class-1 facts.

idea: Count AP, payroll and budgeting removed from Unbound as eliminated labour
argue_against: The work moves to the sponsor ERP; moving work is not elimination (BRIEF).
existing_alternative: Count only the avoided duplicate system and reconciliation
revisit_if: Never.

idea: Drop percentage grants entirely
argue_against: Closing (100%) grants and successor sweeps need a percentage/residual mode (RCF-FIN-022).
revisit_if: If closing grants are modelled only as ResidualSweep.

idea: Skip execution-time status/sanctions checks while a 180-day verification is valid
argue_against: 180 days says nothing about interim revocation or sanctions (CA-180 item 1; XSIM-09); OFAC is strict liability.
existing_alternative: RR-REQ-X-007-r1 two-point check reading reused evidence within the RCD-006 window.
reason_rejected: Weakens IRC 4966/OFAC controls; the check is a cheap deterministic read.
revisit_if: Never for sanctions.

idea: Let AI clear potential sanctions matches or eligibility holds
argue_against: REQ-X-017 and SCV-04: model cannot clear sanctions holds; automation bias.
existing_alternative: Disposition reuse (RR-UNB-EXT-004-r2) and evidence-only AI assistance.
reason_rejected: Legal discretion and strict-liability determinations reserved to authorized humans.
revisit_if: Regulator guidance explicitly permits.

idea: One universal cross-sponsor eligibility decision
argue_against: Sponsors differ in policy (ADV-012); legal reliance is per sponsor per grant date (RCD-006).
reason_rejected: Conflates common facts with sponsor decisions.
revisit_if: Sponsors adopt an identical policy contractually.

idea: Require every charity to onboard and self-attest before receiving grants
argue_against: Moves work to charities (not elimination); ~87,500 charity interactions per 10k accounts [D]; RR-UNB-GRANT-026-r1 already rejects.
existing_alternative: IRS-sourced evidence; entity-type matrix requests only when needed.
reason_rejected: Friction without legal need for listed public charities.
revisit_if: Payment destination enrollment needed for ACH (optional).

idea: Waive the related-party payee block for small grants
argue_against: IRC 4967/4958 have no de minimis for this purpose in the requirements; UNB-RCN-GRT-002 is nonwaivable.
existing_alternative: Deterministic block with fast compliance release on counsel-approved classes.
revisit_if: Counsel identifies a lawful de minimis.

idea: Drop segregation of duties for small staff (one person may request, approve and reconcile).
argue_against: Removes the primary fraud control over charitable assets; breaches GOV-AUTH-004 and fiduciary duty
reason_rejected: Financial integrity and fiduciary accountability are non-negotiable
revisit_if: Never

idea: Replace manual screen-reader testing with automated accessibility scans.
argue_against: Automated tools miss many WCAG failures (general knowledge, unverified)
existing_alternative: Scope manual passes to changed journeys
revisit_if: Measured evidence that automation catches equivalent defects on this stack

idea: Let an AI agent auto-close control deficiencies it judges resolved.
argue_against: Self-certification; breaches OPS-007, RR-UNB-AI-STD-003-r1
existing_alternative: Agent prepares closure evidence; human independent reviewer closes
revisit_if: Never for closure; agent prep remains allowed

idea: Skip tenant-isolation tests in release 1 because there is only one sponsor.
argue_against: Isolation defects become invisible until tenant two; global holds and charity facts already cross tenants
revisit_if: Never

idea: Remove kill-switch two-person rule entirely.
argue_against: Release of a pause resumes money movement and is a misuse vector
revisit_if: n/a

idea: Drop separate contribution acknowledgments and rely on periodic statements
argue_against: Acknowledgment content and timing are statutory (IRC 170(f)(8), 170(f)(18); report 09 line 23); statements are sponsor policy and do not carry the required statements.
existing_alternative: Electronic delivery of acknowledgments; whether several gifts may share one acknowledgment is a counsel question.
reason_rejected: Would remove a legally required document.
revisit_if: Counsel approves a combined acknowledgment format that meets the statute.

idea: Activate successor privileges on a family member's death notification to save verification time
argue_against: UNB-SUCC-006: allegations alone never activate; fraud vector; RR-UNB-SUCC-008-r1 already holds on notice.
existing_alternative: Hold on notice; AI extraction of documents for faster human verification.
revisit_if: Never on notice alone.

idea: Skip identity proofing for co-advisors invited by an already verified donor
argue_for: One less step for family members.
argue_against: Advisory privileges are authority; RCD-023 requires proofing for advisory holders; account-takeover risk.
existing_alternative: Prefill and reuse of verification across funds (RR-ADM-002-r1); view-only participants exempt.
revisit_if: Counsel and security accept a lower assurance level for low-limit recommendation scopes.

idea: Let household membership confer shared access to simplify family servicing
argue_against: RR-ADM-008-r1: household is a view; authority and contributor of record must be explicit.
existing_alternative: Explicit role grants with one-click invitation.
revisit_if: Never.

idea: Remove the 3-business-day destination cooling-off to speed charity bank changes
argue_for: Charities paid sooner after bank change.
argue_against: Primary defence against payee-redirect fraud (UNB-RCN-WF-028, RR-REQ-X-005-r1).
existing_alternative: Notify both channels; allow expedited verification by independent callback where risk is low.
revisit_if: Bank-originated account-ownership verification becomes available per rail.

idea: Delete REQ-X-058..077 and the landscape-wave records outright
argue_against: Loses history and the capability index that maps market capabilities to carriers.
reason_rejected: Index value without test cost is achievable.
revisit_if: Index is unused for two releases.

idea: Let AI choose charitable-default recipients for dormant funds and close them automatically
argue_against: Disposition is an A4 sponsor decision (RR-UNB-WF-015-r1); AI may only suggest from the donor's own history (report 09 line 36).
existing_alternative: Deterministic proposal plus one-click A4 approval.
reason_rejected: AI would exercise legal discretion reserved to the sponsor.
revisit_if: Never for the decision; suggestion only.

idea: Derive the staffing floor as two-deep fixed role-per-person coverage (≈10–12 people)
argue_for: Simple to explain; robust to absence.
argue_against: Assigns one person per role, ignoring per-item SoD evaluation (org §5.2), so it double-counts; over-hires small sponsors.
existing_alternative: UNB-SMP-ORG-002 computed coverage over cross-trained pool.
reason_rejected: Overstates floor; same objective met with 4–5 cross-trained holders.
revisit_if: Regulator or auditor requires fixed role holders.

idea: Human sign-off on every 180-day revalidation or per-grant vetting check
argue_against: Recurring cost with no detection benefit when evidence passes; daf-landscape CA-180-08 proposes no sign-off; routine check is already ≈$0.14/grant at nationals (grt.md:206).
revisit_if: Sampling shows false-clearance rate above tolerance.

idea: Route every AI-assisted output to human review
argue_against: Turns AI into extra work; principle: AI involvement alone never triggers review.
revisit_if: n/a

idea: Zero-employee 'thin sponsor' with all decisions by vendor staff
argue_against: Sponsor must hold exclusive legal control (§4966(d)(2)); UNB-XIN-CLM-008 bars vendor staff from A3+; no accountable officer.
reason_rejected: Legal control and accountability cannot be outsourced.
revisit_if: Counsel approves officer appointment of contracted individuals (SPD-ORG-002) — then S2 becomes viable, not zero staff.

idea: Round robin as the platform-wide default for all queues
argue_against: Ignores skills, relationship continuity and SoD; HWQ notes unfairness with variable complexity (ADV-639).
reason_rejected: Wrong for most DAF case kinds.
revisit_if: n/a

idea: Workload balancing and individual performance by item count or handle time
argue_against: Penalises complex cases; svc.md measurement rules forbid ranking individuals by unadjusted handle time.
revisit_if: n/a

idea: Share sponsor eligibility decisions across sponsors as universal 'approved charity' status
argue_against: Eligibility is sponsor/purpose-specific (UNB-CHAR-018, UNB-CHAR-036, CA-180 #2); per-sponsor reliance snapshot needed (RR-REQ-X-007-r1).
revisit_if: n/a

idea: Infer grant affirmations from past behaviour or a standing profile setting
argue_against: WL-06 forbids consent inferred from silence, AI or unrelated activity. Weak evidence.
existing_alternative: Grouped acknowledgment (SPD-CXP-001) and standing affirmation for schedules
revisit_if: Counsel approves a standing per-fund affirmation with event triggers for one-off grants

idea: Remove step-up for payee and authenticator changes to cut friction
argue_against: Account takeover and payee fraud risk. XID-ADV-008 treats authenticator bindings as authority facts.
revisit_if: Never

idea: Let AI complete donor or charity forms and submit on their behalf
argue_against: AI cannot make personal representations (WL D8). Authority boundary.
revisit_if: Never for representations

idea: Shift identity and bank verification work to charities by requiring platform registration before first grant
argue_against: Moving work to charities is not elimination. It delays grants.
revisit_if: Never

idea: Sponsor-authored policy packs in release 1
argue_against: Infeasible for small sponsors (XIF-ADV-004). Multiplies test permutations.
revisit_if: Several sponsors show sustained demand for materially different baselines

idea: General-purpose no-code rules engine for sponsor policy
argue_against: Executable tenant logic is forbidden (SPONSOR-CONFIGURATION-POLICY-LIFECYCLE: declarative, not executable tenant code). Untestable combinations.
existing_alternative: Typed declarative items with override direction
revisit_if: Never

idea: Per-sponsor counsel approval of every register
argue_against: Cost and delay. Duplicates platform review.
existing_alternative: Attestation of reviewed packs, with counsel review only for deviations
revisit_if: Regulator requires sponsor-specific review of a register

idea: Composite enterprise health score
argue_against: Hides catastrophic single failures. UNB-UI-S-011 forbids it.
revisit_if: Never

idea: User-configurable dashboards in release 1
argue_against: RCD-026 deferred them. Forma lacks composition (DG-01/02). Misleading juxtaposition risk (ADV-722).
revisit_if: Forma composition and charts are proven and users show demand

idea: Individual staff productivity rankings (items/day, handle time)
argue_against: Rewards cherry-picking and premature closure. RR-ADM-042-r1 forbids it without complexity adjustment.
revisit_if: A validated complexity-adjusted measure exists

idea: Net Promoter Score as the headline donor metric
argue_against: No decision linkage. Low response bias.
revisit_if: Sponsor research shows NPS predicts retention in DAFs (no evidence found)

idea: Compete on 'instant approval' or 'grants in 24 hours' marketing claims
argue_for: Speed is a visible donor and charity benefit; competitors market it.
argue_against: No sponsor publishes measured latency; Ren's '98%' figure is coverage policy, not auto-approval; claims invite scrutiny and conflict with sponsor review duties.
reason_rejected: Unmeasured speed claims are not evidence and replicate a weakness of incumbents.
revisit_if: Measured P50/P90 turnaround exists for a production sponsor.

idea: Market Unbound as the only platform with donor data export / public API based on competitor census absences
argue_against: ND is not absence; Daffy and Greater Washington CF already export CSV; logged-in features unchecked.
reason_rejected: Treats absence of public evidence as absence of capability.
revisit_if: Logged-in verification across the top-10 confirms absence.

idea: Differentiate with autonomous AI grant approval
argue_for: Lower cost per grant; marketing novelty.
argue_against: Liability sits with the sponsor and knowing managers (§4966/§4967); no market precedent; AI may add a flag, never clear one.
reason_rejected: Legal discretion reserved to the sponsor; already excluded in the corpus.
revisit_if: Never, absent a change in law and sponsor delegation.

idea: Pursue payroll round-ups and consumer micro-giving as market expansion
argue_against: Corporate micro-giving products closed 2019–2023 (GoFundMe Charity, Virgin Money Giving, BT MyDonate, Google One Today, AmazonSmile); no sponsor offers round-ups; processor accounts average trivial balances.
reason_rejected: Evidence shows borrowed channels vanish and micro-giving habits were not created.
revisit_if: An employer partner commits distribution and covers per-account cost.

idea: Build competitive lock-in by restricting export or history portability
argue_against: History loss is classified as habit and a donor complaint; sponsor exclusive control and exit rights require portability; it would contradict REQ-X-061.
reason_rejected: Lock-in through data is incompatible with stewardship and sponsor control.
revisit_if: Never.

idea: Enter with a free or near-free small-account tier to win share
argue_for: Low price attracts donors; incumbents' minimum fees deter small accounts.
argue_against: Modelled $244–$272 per account-year (illustrative) vs $0 revenue; Daffy and Charityvest both raised effective prices moving upmarket; nonitemizer exclusion weakens small-donor DAF demand.
existing_alternative: Fee floors with shortfall waivers (UNB-XIN-ERP-001) once metered cost exists.
reason_rejected: Negative unit margin with no evidence of expansion.
revisit_if: Metered cost-to-serve (UNB-XIN-SAS-009) is below a viable flat fee.

idea: Introduce a message broker or workflow engine to run minimum-touch automation
source: Common industry pattern for automation at scale (unverified — general knowledge)
argue_against: Measured headroom 10-20x at target load; adds infrastructure and skills for a small team; second log risk
revisit_if: Any ADR falsification criterion met on managed PostgreSQL, or long-running workflow types > ~50

idea: Serve sanctions-relevant holds from a bounded-staleness cache so releases continue during registry outages
argue_for: Removes the SPOF effect on availability
argue_against: Releasing against stale sanctions or revocation data is the failure the hold exists to prevent
reason_rejected: Safety of money movement outranks availability; counsel approval absent
revisit_if: Counsel approves cache for sanctions-neutral hold types only

idea: Auto-release held items after a maximum age to protect SLAs during automation suspension
argue_against: Converts a safety hold into a timer; incentivizes stale-data payments
reason_rejected: Violates fail-closed design and sponsor legal control
revisit_if: Never for eligibility or sanctions holds

idea: Adopt $10 per account as a committed, ratcheted operating budget now
argue_against: Below documented single components; no measured baseline; ratchet with floors deferred
revisit_if: Measured marginal cost by balance band at grade >= B

idea: Treat the thirteen stakeholder passes as validation of the recommendations
argue_against: Same model, same documents; EDF claim policy says lenses from one model are not independent
revisit_if: Never; replace with real reviews

idea: Build a separate platform registry database in release 1 to be ready for multi-sponsor
argue_against: No R1 beneficiary; adds an untested cross-database SPOF
existing_alternative: Logical seam in the sponsor DB (SPD-ARX-001)
revisit_if: A second sponsor is contracted
